## Why Checking Employee Past History Is No Longer Optional


Hiring someone without checking their past history is like signing a lease without reading the fine print — the risk is invisible until it’s too late.


According to[AuthBridge’s Workforce Fraud Files H1 FY26](https://authbridge.com/newsroom/workforce-fraud-files-h1-fy26-hiring-discrepancies-india/) , **4.33% of white-collar hires** and **5.61% of gig workforce candidates** in India carry discrepancies in their employment records. Employment verification was the most affected area for white-collar hires, followed by address and education checks. Separately, an[OnGrid report for FY 2024–25](https://cxotoday.com/press-release/over-3-6-lakh-individuals-had-at-least-one-background-check-fail-in-fy-2024-25-ongrid/) found that **over 3.6 lakh individuals** had at least one background check failure.


For Indian employers, especially startups and SMBs — the traditional route of hiring a background verification agency means:


- **₹1,500–₹8,000 per candidate** depending on the depth of checks
- **3–15 business days** turnaround for employment history verification
- **Minimum commitments** of 50–100 candidates per year
- **No visibility** into the verification process while you wait


This is where **employee past history check apps** have changed the game. These software platforms let HR teams run identity verification, employment history checks, and document authentication directly — without middlemen, without minimum volumes, and often within minutes.


In this guide, we compare 6 employee past history check apps available in India in 2026, starting with the one that offers the best combination of speed, coverage, and affordability for Indian businesses of all sizes.


**What you’ll find in this article:**


1. A side-by-side comparison table of all 6 apps
2. Detailed review of each app — features, pricing, pros, and cons
3. A head-to-head matrix showing what each app can and cannot check
4. A decision framework to help you pick the right app for your team size and budget

## #2 SpringVerify — Best for Startups Needing HRMS Integration


**Website:**[springverify.com](https://www.springverify.com/)


**Overview:** SpringVerify (by Springworks) is a digital-first employee background check platform popular with Indian startups and tech companies. It focuses on making background verification part of the hiring and onboarding workflow rather than a standalone process.


### What SpringVerify Checks for Past History


Check Type Available How It Works


Employment Verification ✅ Yes Contacts previous employers directly via email/phone; verifies designation, tenure, and exit type


Education Verification ✅ Yes Verifies degree, university, and year of passing through institutional outreach


Identity Verification ✅ Yes PAN, Aadhaar (limited), and ID document matching


Criminal Record Check ✅ Yes Court record search across districts; database + physical verification


Address Verification ✅ Yes Physical address check via field agents


UAN/EPFO Check ❌ No Does not pull EPFO employment history directly


### Pros


- ✅ **ATS and HRMS integrations** — connects with Keka, Darwinbox, Recruitee, and other popular Indian HR tools
- ✅ **WhatsApp-based candidate consent** — candidates receive verification requests on WhatsApp, making consent collection fast
- ✅ **Dashboard tracking** — real-time status updates for each candidate’s verification progress
- ✅ **Startup-friendly** — designed for companies hiring 10–200 employees per year; no massive enterprise contracts


### Cons


- ❌ **Employment verification takes 2–5 business days** — relies on contacting previous employers, not instant database checks
- ❌ **No direct EPFO/UAN past history pull** — cannot independently verify employment tenure from government records
- ❌ **Pricing not transparent** — requires a demo or sales conversation to get a quote
- ❌ **Limited physical verification reach** in Tier-3 cities and rural areas


### Pricing


SpringVerify uses package-based pricing. Basic identity checks start at approximately ₹200–₹500 per candidate, while comprehensive packages (employment + education + criminal + address) can range from ₹1,500–₹3,000 per candidate. Exact pricing requires contacting their sales team.


### Verdict


SpringVerify is a solid choice if you need background checks integrated directly into your hiring pipeline and your HR team already uses tools like Keka or Darwinbox. However, for **instant past employment history** verification via government records, SalaryBox Verify delivers results in minutes where SpringVerify takes days.


## #3 AuthBridge — Best for Large Enterprises With High-Volume Hiring


**Website:**[authbridge.com](https://authbridge.com/)


**Overview:** AuthBridge is one of India’s oldest and largest background verification companies, serving enterprise clients across BFSI, IT, pharma, retail, and telecom. They publish the annual[Workforce Fraud Files](https://authbridge.com/newsroom/workforce-fraud-files-h1-fy26-hiring-discrepancies-india/) report, which tracks hiring discrepancies across sectors. AuthBridge offers a technology platform backed by a physical verification network.


### What AuthBridge Checks for Past History


Check Type Available How It Works


Employment Verification ✅ Yes Multi-channel: employer outreach, EPFO cross-check, and HR reference calls; covers tenure, designation, salary, and exit reason


Education Verification ✅ Yes University and institution outreach; covers degree, specialisation, year of passing


Identity Verification ✅ Yes PAN, Aadhaar, Voter ID, DL, and passport verification against government databases


Criminal Record Check ✅ Yes Database + physical court record check across 600+ districts


Address Verification ✅ Yes Physical field verification with geo-tagged photographs


Global Database Check ✅ Yes OFAC, PEP, sanctions, and adverse media screening


### Pros


- ✅ **Most comprehensive check coverage** — covers every verification type including global sanctions and adverse media
- ✅ **AI-driven workflows** — uses machine learning to flag discrepancies faster within their platform
- ✅ **600+ district court network** — physical criminal record checks across India
- ✅ **Industry benchmarks** — their Workforce Fraud Files report provides sector-specific fraud data useful for internal audits


### Cons


- ❌ **Not self-serve** — requires an account manager; you cannot sign up and run a check immediately
- ❌ **Enterprise pricing** — typically requires annual contracts with minimum volume commitments; not suitable for companies hiring fewer than 50 people per year
- ❌ **Turnaround time: 3–10 business days** — comprehensive checks involve physical verification and employer outreach
- ❌ **No pay-per-check option** — you cannot verify a single candidate without a contract in place
- ❌ **Higher pricing** — comprehensive packages range from ₹2,500–₹8,000+ per candidate depending on check depth


### Pricing


AuthBridge operates on enterprise contracts. Basic digital verification packages start around ₹1,500–₹2,500 per candidate. Comprehensive packages including employment + education + criminal + address + global checks range from ₹4,000–₹8,000+ per candidate. Annual minimum commitments are standard.


### Verdict


AuthBridge is the right choice for large enterprises (500+ hires/year) that need every type of check — including physical address verification and court record searches — and have the budget and hiring volume to justify an enterprise contract. For smaller companies that primarily need **past employment history checks via government records** , SalaryBox Verify delivers the same UAN/EPFO data at a fraction of the cost and in a fraction of the time.


## #4 OnGrid — Best for Gig Economy and Blue-Collar Past History Checks


**Website:**[ongrid.in](https://ongrid.in/)


**Overview:** OnGrid is an API-first verification platform built for high-volume, fast-turnaround use cases. It’s particularly popular with gig economy platforms, logistics companies, and staffing agencies that onboard hundreds of blue-collar and field workers every month. Founded by IIT Bombay alumni, OnGrid focuses on making verification programmable through APIs.


### What OnGrid Checks for Past History


Check Type Available How It Works


Employment Verification ✅ Yes API-based verification via EPFO/UAN and employer outreach


Identity Verification ✅ Yes PAN, Aadhaar, DL, Voter ID, and passport via government APIs


Criminal Record Check ✅ Yes Database search + court record verification


Address Verification ✅ Yes Digital address verification and geo-tagged field checks


Education Verification ✅ Yes University outreach-based verification


Drug Test Coordination ✅ Yes Partners with labs for pre-employment drug screening


### Pros


- ✅ **API-first architecture** — integrates directly into your ATS, HRMS, or custom onboarding workflow via REST APIs
- ✅ **Built for volume** — handles hundreds of verifications per day; ideal for staffing agencies and gig platforms
- ✅ **Instant ID verification** — PAN, Aadhaar, and DL checks return results in real-time through API calls
- ✅ **FY 2024–25 data benchmark** — OnGrid’s own report found[3.6 lakh individuals with at least one failed check](https://cxotoday.com/press-release/over-3-6-lakh-individuals-had-at-least-one-background-check-fail-in-fy-2024-25-ongrid/) , showing scale and data depth


### Cons


- ❌ **Not designed for non-technical HR teams** — the API-first approach means you need a developer to set up integrations
- ❌ **No simple web dashboard for one-off checks** — less suitable for an HR manager who wants to verify a single candidate without coding
- ❌ **Employment verification (employer outreach) takes 1–3 days** — instant checks are limited to ID documents
- ❌ **Limited enterprise customisation** for complex multi-entity organisations


### Pricing


OnGrid uses API-based usage pricing. Identity verification calls (PAN, Aadhaar, DL) are typically priced at ₹5–₹25 per call. Employment verification packages range from ₹500–₹2,000 per candidate depending on depth. Volume discounts are available for 500+ checks per month.


### Verdict


OnGrid is excellent for tech-savvy companies that hire at volume and want to embed verification into their own systems. But if you’re an HR manager who wants to check one candidate’s past employment history without writing code, **SalaryBox Verify’s browser-based self-serve interface** is a far simpler path to the same government database checks.

Identity Verification ✅ Yes PAN, Aadhaar, Voter ID, DL, and passport via AI-powered OCR + government database matching


Criminal Record Check ✅ Yes Database screening across courts; physical verification available as add-on


Education Verification ✅ Yes Degree and institution verification through outreach


Address Verification ✅ Yes Digital verification + field verification options


Face Match / Liveness ✅ Yes AI-based facial recognition matching candidate’s photo against ID documents


### Pros


- ✅ **AI-driven fraud detection** — uses machine learning to spot tampered documents, photo mismatches, and suspicious patterns
- ✅ **Strong KYC capabilities** — if your industry requires RBI-mandated KYC (BFSI, lending, insurance), IDfy handles both KYC and BGV
- ✅ **Face match and liveness detection** — can verify that the person submitting documents is the actual candidate, not an impersonator
- ✅ **Fast ID checks** — identity document verification returns results in seconds through API


### Cons


- ❌ **Employment history check is not instant** — relies on employer outreach, taking 3–7 business days; does not pull EPFO records directly
- ❌ **Primarily an API/enterprise product** — small businesses may find the integration effort disproportionate for occasional checks
- ❌ **Custom pricing only** — no published pricing; requires a sales conversation
- ❌ **KYC focus can mean over-engineering** for companies that only need employment history and ID checks


### Pricing


IDfy uses custom enterprise pricing. Identity verification API calls are competitively priced for volume users (estimated ₹5–₹30 per call). Employment verification packages are typically ₹1,000–₹3,000 per candidate depending on the depth of checks. No published price list is available.


### Verdict


IDfy is an excellent choice for BFSI and fintech companies that need combined KYC + background verification with AI-powered fraud detection. However, for straightforward **employee past history checks** — verifying where someone worked before and for how long — SalaryBox Verify pulls the same EPFO data instantly without the complexity of an enterprise API integration.

Identity Verification ✅ Yes PAN and Aadhaar verification against government databases

### Pros


- ✅ **Industry-leading OCR accuracy** — extracts data from even low-quality scans, photographs, and mobile camera captures of documents
- ✅ **Instant document verification** — PAN and Aadhaar verification results in under 5 seconds via API
- ✅ **Fraud detection on documents** — detects tampered documents, photoshopped IDs, and digitally altered certificates

### Pricing


HyperVerge charges per API call. Document OCR calls typically cost ₹3–₹10 per extraction. Government database verification (PAN, Aadhaar) costs ₹5–₹25 per call. Face match is priced separately. Volume discounts are available for high-throughput use cases. No published pricing for small businesses.


### Verdict


HyperVerge is a powerful tool if your verification workflow starts with documents — scanning IDs, extracting data, and matching faces. But it is **not an employee past history check app** in the traditional sense. It cannot tell you where a candidate worked before or verify their employment tenure. For that, you need SalaryBox Verify’s EPFO/UAN-based past employment check, which is purpose-built for this exact use case.

Most Indian companies don’t need just one app. The smartest approach is to layer tools based on what each does best:


**Layer 1 — Foundation (Every hire, Day One):** Use **SalaryBox Verify** to instantly check PAN, Voter ID, Driving Licence, UAN, and past employment history. This covers 80% of what you need to catch resume fraud and identity mismatches. Cost: minimal. Time: under 10 minutes.


**Layer 2 — Risk-Based (For sensitive roles):** Add criminal record checks and address verification through **SpringVerify** or **AuthBridge** for roles that handle money, data, or vulnerable populations. Cost: ₹1,500–₹4,000 per candidate. Time: 3–7 days.


**Layer 3 — Compliance (For regulated industries):** Add **IDfy** for KYC-mandated checks, face matching, and global sanctions screening in BFSI and lending. Cost: custom. Time: instant for ID, 3–7 days for full BGV.


This layered approach gives you **instant coverage for every hire** at the lowest possible cost, with deeper checks added only where the role demands it.

## FAQs About Employee Past History Check Apps in India


### What is an employee past history check app?


An employee past history check app is a software platform that allows employers to verify a candidate’s previous employment records, identity documents, and other background details online — without hiring a traditional background verification agency. These apps typically access government databases (EPFO, Income Tax, Election Commission, Parivahan) to validate information that candidates provide during hiring.


### Can I check an employee’s past employment history online in India?


Yes. Apps like SalaryBox Verify can pull past employment history directly from EPFO (Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation) using the candidate’s UAN (Universal Account Number). This shows previous employer names, tenure (joining and exit dates), and establishment details — all sourced from government records, not self-reported information.


### Which employee past history check app is best for small businesses in India?


SalaryBox Verify is the best option for small businesses because it offers pay-per-check pricing with no minimum volume requirement, instant results for government database checks, and a fully self-serve interface that doesn’t require a sales call or enterprise contract.


### How much does an employee past history check cost in India?


Costs vary widely by app and check type. Self-serve platforms like SalaryBox Verify offer transparent per-check pricing (exact price shown before checkout). Enterprise platforms like AuthBridge charge ₹2,500–₹8,000+ per candidate for comprehensive packages. API-based tools like OnGrid charge ₹5–₹25 per identity check and ₹500–₹2,000 for employment verification.


### How long does an employee past history check take?


It depends on the app and check type. SalaryBox Verify delivers instant results for PAN, Voter ID, DL, and UAN checks, and past employment history results within 10 minutes. Agency-backed platforms like AuthBridge and SpringVerify take 2–10 business days for employment verification because they contact previous employers manually.


### Is it legal to check an employee’s past history in India without their consent?


No. Under the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023 and existing privacy norms, employers must obtain written consent from the candidate before running any background or identity verification checks. Most apps include built-in consent collection workflows (e.g., SpringVerify uses WhatsApp-based consent). SalaryBox Verify requires the employer to have candidate consent before initiating checks.


### What documents can I verify using an employee past history check app?


Depending on the app, you can verify PAN cards, Aadhaar cards, Voter IDs, Driving Licences, UAN/EPFO records, educational certificates, previous employment letters, and criminal records. SalaryBox Verify specifically covers PAN, Voter ID, DL, UAN, and past employment history against government databases.


### Can these apps detect fake experience certificates?


Apps that check past employment history through EPFO/UAN records (like SalaryBox Verify and OnGrid) can reveal whether the candidate was actually employed at the companies they claim — because EPFO records show the actual employer who deposited PF contributions. If a candidate claims 3 years at Company X but EPFO shows no record, that’s a red flag. However, no app can directly authenticate a physical experience certificate’s signature or letterhead.


### Do I need a developer to use an employee past history check app?


Not for all apps. SalaryBox Verify and SpringVerify offer web-based dashboards that any HR manager can use without technical skills. OnGrid, IDfy, and HyperVerge are primarily API-based products that require developer integration. AuthBridge is managed through an account manager.


### Can I use multiple employee past history check apps together?


Yes, and it’s often the smartest approach. Use SalaryBox Verify as your foundation layer for instant ID and employment history checks on every hire. Then add SpringVerify or AuthBridge for criminal and address checks on high-risk roles. And IDfy for KYC-mandated checks in regulated industries. This layered approach gives you comprehensive coverage at the lowest total cost.
